title: How did the Sikhs attain sovereignty?

blocks.text: Then Murray asked me to explain this much: how did the Sikhs attain sovereignty, and which king bestowed that sovereignty upon them? (33)
In reply I told him that the Sikhs received sovereignty as the true gift of the Guru.
When Murray asked which true sovereign had granted it, I answered: Guru Nanak was that sovereign. (34)
